feature_description: Feature: interaction-file-logging — capture all human and LLM interaction inputs and outputs to a file log. Requirements: (1) Log every interaction with the user and with the LLM, recording both the input and the output of each interaction. (2) Store the log in JSON format. (3) Use a hidden directory named .powdrr and a file named interaction-log.json within it (i.e., .powdrr/interaction-log.json). The log should capture the full input and output of each human or LLM interaction.
